name: Awesome_Spatial_VQA_Benchmarks
description: A curated collection of spatial visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks aimed at measuring models' spatial and relational reasoning about images. It evaluates ability to answer questions about object relationships, relative positions, directions, and counts, probing compositional and geometric reasoning in vision-language models. The collection is intended to support comparison across datasets and to highlight spatial reasoning strengths and weaknesses.
reputation: Moderately referenced by researchers working on spatial reasoning in vision-and-language; useful as a curated collection though not a single unified benchmark.
